Metadata.title: OpsHub | Service request operations
Metadata.description: Receive, review and deliver service requests from one clear workspace.

PublicHome.title: Every request. One clear path forward.
PublicHome.description: Give clients one simple place to ask for help. Review every request with context, make a clear decision, and keep delivery moving without chasing messages or spreadsheets.
PublicHome.formNote: Try the demo request form. No account needed.
PublicHome.workflowEyebrow: Built for the way small teams work
PublicHome.workflowTitle: From first message to finished handoff
PublicHome.workflowDescription: One shared flow keeps the request, the decision, and the delivery record together.
PublicHome.step1Description: A focused bilingual form collects what the team needs without forcing the client to create an account.
PublicHome.step2Description: Approvers see the original request, start review deliberately, and record one accountable final decision.
PublicHome.step3Description: Durable automation delivers approved requests and makes retries or failures visible to administrators.
PublicHome.aiTitle: Help when it is useful. Control where it matters.
PublicHome.aiDescription: The assistant can answer approved service questions and help shape a request. It never submits, approves, or decides for the team.
PublicHome.aiPoint3: The normal form is always available
PublicHome.finalTitle: Make the next request easier to handle.
PublicHome.finalDescription: Start with the demo form and see the complete bilingual intake experience.
